cards.title: The next piece
cards.text: Everything so far is marked good. Which comes next? Tick more than one if you like.
cards.why: You asked for more polish and charm earlier; the build order also has more modules, Runes and between-run progress.
cards.details:
Polish: walk bob and squash on you, enemy faces and idle wobbles, a dash trail that bends, floor dust, shard and key pickup fanfare, a proper game-over screen with your run's numbers.

Modules: Orbit, Return, Shrapnel, Trail, Echo, Leech, Pull from the design, each on all your casts.

Runes: modules that cast another spell on hit, on wall, on end, every second or on kill.

Between runs: what you keep after a run (slots, unlocks, starting choices).
